title: NASA telepathy experiments and remote viewing the moon

tellings.quote: So he he claims that they sent remote viewers to the moon

plain: In the 1960s, according to a man named Andrija Puharich, NASA ran telepathy experiments and sent "remote viewers" to the moon. Remote viewers are people said to describe faraway places with the mind alone. The researcher Greg Malatzi gives Puharich's claim on the show, pointing to newspaper articles and to NASA contracts Puharich held, and if it were true it would mean the space agency tested psychic spying beyond Earth.
